```{r}

# https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/BLSloadR/BLSloadR.pdf
library("BLSloadR")

laus_states <- get_laus()
laus_states_unadjusted <- get_laus("state_unadjusted")

tmp <- laus_states |>
  filter(area_text == "New York")

tmp |>
  filter(measure_text == "employment") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = value)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal()

```
